title: Alton Law
text: I am an undergraduate student in the Department of Statistics & Data Science at UCLA. My work focuses on the intersection of statistical modeling and computational data science, with a particular interest in solving complex spatial and predictive problems. I have a strong foundation in geostatistics, Monte Carlo simulations, and supervised learning methods like linear regressions and decision trees.
